marta: quick Q — should saved queries inherit route sampling by default or be independent?
alex: inherit by default. Otherwise cost previews break.
rico: allow overrides for investigations but keep inherit default.
tara: UX: show "Sampling: inherit (10%)" and dropdown with buckets [1,5,10,25,100].
marta: backend: enforce buckets, return effective_sample_rate in GET.
alex: API: sample_policy: "inherit|override", sample_rate: "1|5|10|25|100".
rico: metrics: add sample_bucket to metric key but keep aggregate route charts across buckets.
deploy-bot: feature flag `savedquery_sampling_override` created for canary rollout.
